title: Supporting Rajam Deaf & Dumb School & Old Age Home
description: Providing essential resources to improve transportation and daily living facilities for students and senior citizens in Rajam.
longDescription: AMSS supported Rajam Deaf & Dumb School by donating MRF tyres for the school van, ensuring safer transportation for students. An iron stand was also donated to Rajam Old Age Home to improve daily facilities for elderly residents.
location: Rajam Deaf & Dumb School & Rajam Old Age Home, Srikakulam District, Andhra Pradesh
missionImpact: Donated MRF tyres for the school van and an iron stand for clothes at Rajam Old Age Home, improving transportation safety for students and enhancing daily facilities for senior citizens.

title: AMSS 1st Anniversary Celebration & Daily Needs Distribution
description: Celebrating the first anniversary of AMSS by donating essential daily-use items to support those in need.
longDescription: On the occasion of the 1st anniversary of AMSS, the team donated essential daily-use items, including brushes, Rin soap, 15 buckets, 20 jugs, and shampoo, to support the everyday needs of the beneficiaries. Nearly 50 members came together to celebrate this milestone through an act of service and compassion.
missionImpact: Distributed essential daily-use items, including brushes, Rin soap, 15 buckets, 20 jugs, and shampoo, benefiting the local community while celebrating the 1st anniversary of AMSS.

title: Blankets & Groceries Distribution at Grace Land Trust
description: Providing blankets, groceries, and essential supplies to orphanage children at Grace Land Trust.
longDescription: AMSS organized a donation drive at Grace Land Trust, providing blankets, groceries, and other essential daily-use items for orphanage children. The initiative was conducted to ensure the children had greater comfort, care, and support in their daily lives.
location: Grace Land Trust, Vepagunta, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh
missionImpact: Distributed blankets, carpets, groceries, and essential daily-use items worth ₹19,150, bringing comfort and care to orphanage children at Grace Land Trust.

title: Daily Needs & Groceries Distribution at Brighter Future Development Trust
description: Providing daily essentials and groceries to 130 orphanage children at Brighter Future Development Trust.
longDescription: AMSS organized a community support drive at Brighter Future Development Trust, donating daily-use essentials and groceries to 130 orphanage children. The initiative was aimed at supporting their everyday needs and bringing care, hope, and happiness to the children.
location: Brighter Future Development Trust, Gotlam, Vizianagaram District, Andhra Pradesh
missionImpact: Distributed daily essentials and groceries worth ₹22,456, supporting the well-being of 130 orphanage children at Brighter Future Development Trust.

title: Groceries Distribution at Mana Kutumbam Orphanage
description: Providing two months' worth of groceries and daily essentials to children at Mana Kutumbam Orphanage.
longDescription: AMSS donated two months' worth of groceries and essential daily-use items to Mana Kutumbam Orphanage, supporting the nutritional and daily needs of 30 orphanage children. The initiative aimed to ensure the children had access to essential supplies and a healthier living environment.
missionImpact: Provided two months' worth of groceries and daily essentials worth ₹17,882, ensuring continued nutritional support and improved well-being for 30 orphanage children.

title: Wall Fans Donation at Karthavya Orphanage Home
description: Donating two wall fans to improve the comfort of children at Karthavya Orphanage Home.
longDescription: AMSS donated two wall fans to Karthavya Orphanage Home to provide a more comfortable living environment for the children. This contribution was made to support their daily needs and improve their well-being.
missionImpact: Donated two wall fans worth ₹4,500, helping create a more comfortable and healthier environment for orphanage children.

title: Education Support for a Child in Memory of Her Father
description: Providing financial assistance to support a child's education after the sudden loss of her father.
longDescription: AMSS extended educational support to the daughter of a family who lost their father unexpectedly at APRDC, Nagarjuna Sagar, Moula Ali. A financial contribution was provided to help continue the child's education and ease the family's burden during a difficult time.
missionImpact: Provided ₹5,000 in educational assistance to help a child continue her education following the sudden loss of her father.

title: Medical & Emergency Financial Assistance
description: Providing financial assistance to individuals and families in need for medical treatments and emergency healthcare.
longDescription: AMSS has continuously extended financial support to individuals facing medical emergencies and critical health conditions. Through the generous contributions of volunteers and supporters, assistance was provided for accident treatments, brain injury, bone cancer, kidney disease, and emergency medical care for children. Every contribution reflects our commitment to standing with families during their most challenging times.
missionImpact: Provided emergency financial assistance totaling ₹18,000 to eight individuals, helping them access timely medical treatment and healthcare support.

title: Emergency Support for Child Bhanu Prakash
description: Providing financial assistance to support the well-being of child Bhanu Prakash during a critical situation.
longDescription: AMSS provided financial assistance to child Bhanu Prakash during a critical situation, helping meet urgent needs and offering timely support to the family. This contribution reflects our commitment to protecting and supporting children in times of need.
missionImpact: Provided ₹2,000 in emergency financial assistance to support child Bhanu Prakash during a critical situation.
